create_RobotiqGripperSensor: create a RobotiqGripperSensor instance with a gripper object and a name string
initialize_RobotiqGripperSensor_for_task: initialize a RobotiqGripperSensor for a task with control and physics timestep parameters
get_observables_from_RobotiqGripperSenso: get the observables dictionary from a RobotiqGripperSensor after calling initialize_for_task
get_gripper_position: get the gripper joint position sensor data from the physics simulation
get_gripper_grasp_state: get the gripper grasp state as a uint8 numpy array from the physics simulation
